idea-plugin.name: Terraform Provider Pin Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the .tf lines a clean terraform init is still free to move

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Terraform Provider Pin Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/terraform-provider-pin-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/terraform-provider-pin-lint

action.text: Terraform Provider Pin Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Terraform Provider Pin Lint on the file in the editor
